attention.rejection_reason: Full Q8 attention residency would consume nearly the entire D02 safe RSS budget before KV, output, experts, runtime and I/O buffers.

budget_items.basis: Conservative fixed runtime/native heap allowance until P-stage service RSS measures it.

budget_items.basis: Exact manifest bytes for router, normalization, attention bias and sink tensors.

budget_items.basis: Largest layer-local Q8 attention matrix bundle; all-layer resident attention is rejected.
budget_items.name: attention_layer_q8_stream_buffer

budget_items.basis: Four selected experts for one layer using exact H40M expert tensor bytes divided by 32 local experts.
budget_items.name: minimum_top4_expert_cache

budget_items.basis: 24 layers * 8 KV heads * 64 head dim * K/V * BF16 * 1024 tokens.
budget_items.name: kv_cache_1024_bf16

budget_items.basis: Two 16MiB I/O windows matching D04 expert-shaped read sizes.
budget_items.name: io_double_buffer

budget_items.basis: Bounded hidden, attention score, logits chunk, dequant and temporary compute scratch.
budget_items.name: activation_and_logits_scratch
